dct_title_s: Nieuw nederlandtsch caertboeck. : waer in volkomentlijcker als oyt te voren vertoont werden de XVII. Nederlanden, too in't geheel, als elck besonder met grote neersticheyt ende kosten gesneden ende in'tlicht gebracht
dct_description_sm: door Abraham Goos; Mitsgaders een nieuwe beschryvinge uijt verscheyden autheuren ordentlyck tsamen gestelt door Reinier Telle...
Engraved t.p. "P.S. schul." at bottom left. "B.B." at bottom right. Includes figures, ships, instruments, sea serpent and model of this book showing text and map.
"Gedruckt t Amsterdam by Abraham Goos Plaetfynder was nende op den Dam in'tvergul: de Caertboeck." -- title page.

Includes maps of Holland and Belgium, both provinces and urban areas. They are uniformly 12.3 x 17.6cm and enclosed in an ellipse with directions, decorative corners and usually lat & long. Cartouches are present, physical features are seen, scales are present.

Map 1. Belgium sive inferior Germania -- Map 2. Belgium vetus -- Map 3. Ducatus Brabantiae -- Map 4. Limburgo ducatus -- Map 5. Ducatus Lutzenburgicus -- Map 6. Geldrea ducatus -- Map 7. Comitatus Flandria -- Map 8. Artesia comitatus -- Map 9. Comitatus Hannonia -- Map 10. Comitatus Hollandia -- Map 11. Hollandia Meridionalis -- Map 12. Hollandia Septent -- Map 13. Agri Zypani Descrip -- Map 14. Agri Biemstrani Descr -- Map 15. Zelandia comitatus -- Map 16. Comitatus Namruci -- Map 17. Comit. Zutphania -- Map 18. Marchionatus Sacri Imperii -- Map 19. Frisia Occidentalis -- Map 20. Mechlinia dominium -- Map 21. Ultrai[j]ectum -- Map 22. Ditio Trans-isulana -- Map 23. Groninga dominium.
National Maritime Museum Catalogue n. 91, p. 82.
Previlegie is pasted in. Early pagination is odd 1,2, (map Belgium sive Germania Inferior) 7, 8, 9, 2? (map Belgium Vetus), 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12 etc.
